source: https://etravel.gov.ph — Data Policy (collected items), declaration form i18n catalog (field labels, MM/DD/YYYY date hint), FAQ (QR rules), re-checked 2026-09-04

passport.label: Passport Number
passport.help: Use the passport number from the photo page. No spaces or dashes.

errors.tooShort: Passport number too short — min 6 characters
errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 12 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.help: The form asks First / Middle / Last / Suffix in separate boxes. Use the Latin spelling from your passport.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: The official form marks date fields (MM/DD/YYYY). This local checker takes YYYY-MM-DD.

errors.tooEarly: Date of birth seems too far in the past
errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be in the future

mobile_number.label: Mobile Number
mobile_number.help: Include your country code. This local checker accepts + followed by 7 to 15 digits.

errors.invalidFormat: Use + country code and 7 to 15 digits

flight_number.label: Flight Number
flight_number.help: Operating carrier code + number. Sea travelers: the form asks for Voyage Number and Vessel Name instead.

errors.invalidFormat: Use carrier code + number, e.g. PR103

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: Date you land in Philippine local time. The form shows (MM/DD/YYYY); this checker takes YYYY-MM-DD. Registration opens 72 hours before arrival.

email.label: Email address
email.help: Use an inbox you can open at the airport. Sign-up sends a 6-digit OTP here.
